{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & completed_mask]

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Print all required evidence
print(f'Number of completed orders after filtering: {len(filtered_df)}')
print(f'Average revenue per converted order for email: {avg_revenue_by_channel['email']:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue per converted order for paid_search: {avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']:.2f}')
print(f'Conversion rate for email: {conversion_rate_by_channel['email']:.3f}')
print(f'Conversion rate for paid_search: {conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']:.3f}')"}
